market.what: PFAS ion-exchange resin + GAC change-outs where short-chain PFAS (PFBA, PFBS, PFHxA) set bed life, world
market.method: IX ~27.6% of ~$2.2B PFAS treatment (2025) = ~$0.6B; IX is today's tool for short-chain; est.

value.logic: short-chain PFCA break through IX in <=61 d and GAC in <=142 d (441-d pilot); EU ~$0.4B/yr + US/other ~$0.2B/yr of media spend is short-chain-limited; 3x bed life cuts ~40% -> ~$0.25B/yr
value.revenue_logic: ~4% of ~$0.6B IX/short-chain media by yr 7 via resin maker licence + own sales
value.margin_logic: premium selective resin (no good substitute for PFBA); macrocycle cost higher than quat resin

trend.drivers: EU DWD sum of 20 PFAS (incl. C4-C7) 0.1 ug/L from Jan 2026; PFAS-selective IX fastest-growing media (8-13%/yr); US PFBS hazard index being dropped (minus)
trend.deadline: EU DWD PFAS limits in force 12 Jan 2026 (3-5 yr build lag)

competition.notes: groups capped at 200. PFBA still poorly removed by any media; fluorogel sorbents (academic) beat IX 3x on short-chain. Puraffinity $25.8M; Oxyle $16M targets ultra-short by destruction

lab.synth: macrocycle/polymer/resin: p-bromocalix[4]arene is ~2 steps from catalog p-tert-butylcalix[4]arene, then grafting to a bead
lab.test: batch isotherms + RSSCT (ASTM D6586) with PFBA/PFBS/PFHxA in tap-water matrix; EPA 533 (covers C4) e.g. MSU Center for PFAS Research
lab.logic: 12-14 wk synth+graft, 3 variants ($25-35k) + 4-5 wk tests; ~60 EPA 533 x $241 = ~$15k

sale.gates: NSF/ANSI 61 (US) and German UBA/4MS approval of treatment material (EU); utility pilot ~12 mo
